name: Mima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mima city emblem in blue, green and pink: a blue ring enclosing green stylised hills with a pink disc.
history: Municipal flag of Mima, a city in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2005.

features.role: Mima city emblem — a blue ring enclosing green stylised hills with a pink disc
